context_policy: Full allowed case where it fits; otherwise old exact windows with preserved boundary and coverage.
training_time_basis: old CE approximately5.3h; source/peer information longer; one fixed 24h CE cap, no hyperparameter search

label_contract.SUPPORTED: Source supports this exact evidentiary use, including valid opposition. Not whole-premise truth.
label_contract.UNSUPPORTED: Demonstrable source, attribution, object, direction, court-stage or scope error in this use.
label_contract.UNRESOLVED: Shared input insufficient, or genuinely unresolved source-grounded competing interpretations.
label_contract.dispute: True only for grounded unresolved alternatives about the reference label after applying the use contract. Not disagreement with P, litigant disagreement, or opposition direction.
label_contract.mandatory_basis_refs: Only source addresses essential to deciding this label. Must be in learner-visible same-case packet union for supervision.
label_contract.outside_packet_dependencies: Only indispensable dependencies absent from that union. Supplementary outside references alone do not exclude supervision.
label_contract.refs: All actual citations supporting the review; may include explicitly supplementary explanation. Quote must locate exactly in these refs.
label_contract.legacy: No bulk flag changes. Reuse requires independently documented semantic compatibility; this version new P has changed prompts so old P-dependent labels are not reused.

web_mode: Extra High required; actual visible model/settings verified before first new submission, never inferred

web_slots.label_output_estimate: 300_tokens_per_declared_use + 500; checked against realized P before submission

web_resource_policy: maximum60one-shot slots, no retries/continuations; compatible cached refs reused; reference patch only demonstrated gaps. Access failure preserves unsubmitted slots for recovery.

evaluation.reference_policy: Reuse independent Q1 sources; only missing/unclear/conflicting items may be supplemented. Preserve originals and revisions uniformly across all methods.
evaluation.reference_input_isolation: DEV evaluation reference never enters local prompt, graph, candidates, checker acceptance policy, or final generation. DEV local classification labels used only for validation/evaluation, not gradients.
evaluation.claim_split_rule: A substantive judgement is one independently assessable proposition about a fact/object/event/status/stage, a rule/scope/exception, an application, or a conclusion. Split only when clauses can have different truth or support values. Merge repetitions and paraphrases of the same proposition, across fields. Do not count citations, headings, stylistic remarks, or every word as claims. An explicitly qualified uncertainty or assumption is assessed in its stated scope. Distinguish an asserted fact from an attributed claim. Alternative accounts of the same issue remain different claims when their speakers, objects, stage, or asserted content differ.

full_answer_primary_metrics.key_content_coverage: correctly_handled_distinct_reference_items / all_frozen_key_items; correct sourced uncertainty counts; omitted/wrong items do not

evaluation.major_error_definition: Decisive wrong source attribution, object, court stage, rule scope, necessary condition, or conclusion direction. Cosmetic differences excluded.
evaluation.aggregation: request metrics -> within-dispute means -> equal dispute weighting. Completion on all planned conditions; semantic metrics on eligible completed answers with denominators retained.

blind_evaluation.limits: Structure/content may reveal method; do not claim complete blinding. No method names/model confidence provenance shown to reviewer.

evaluation.evaluation_evidence: Complete allowed source plus frozen checklist; new out-of-checklist claims must be checked against source, never marked wrong merely because absent from checklist.
evaluation.decisive_disagreement_review: One concentrated local source review; retain reference amendments and rescore ALL related conditions uniformly. No local answer retries.
evaluation.prediction_to_answer_trace: connection id, raw P label, predicted label, audit/material consequence, final adoption/rejection/reinterpretation, source-grounded effect; common fixes not attributed to learners

framework_support_evidence: models/qwen3_5/language.py Attention passes max_position_embeddings to Qwen3_5RotaryEmbedding and keeps cache offset
resource_support.KV_estimate_formula: 8 full-attention layers * 2(K,V) * 4 kv_heads *256 head_dim *65536 positions *2 bytes =2147483648; float32 upper estimate doubles. Linear recurrent layers fixed state. Estimate excludes weights/prefill activations/OS/other apps.
resource_support.decision: 65536 within actual native config and loaded framework; feasible bounded attempt, not guaranteed capacity or quality

cross_rule_contract_inventory.scope: Only existing explicit per-rule compositions; OPEN_TEXT and missing cross-rule dependencies not invented.

actual_entry.real_entry: run_local -> Runner.run -> schedule -> consolidate -> source/binding/dependency independent check

early_P_stop: Both same repetition or truncation, unreadable => stop further P; no prompt retry

production_policy.cached_P: V19_1/V19_2 original bytes with deterministic valid-reference adapter, invalid references remain rejected

type_policy_effect: Unmapped descriptors retained as explicit unverified model type/role assumptions for conditional derivation; never verified compatibility, never an identity merge. Mapped disjoint domains reject locally.
training_and_checked_final_gate: Common type acceptance and actual common encoding PASS required; original data/resource gates and budget remain unchanged.

reference_contract.source: SRC:n selects the n-th entry of the frozen allowed-source directory
reference_contract.record: EV:n selects the n-th record within the current analysis
reference_contract.object: OBJ:n selects the n-th object within the current analysis
reference_contract.use: USE:n selects the n-th use within the current analysis
reference_contract.component: COMP:n selects the n-th component; WHOLE_JUDGMENT is explicit whole scope
reference_contract.ordinal_policy: One-based array positions assigned by code; no model-declared duplicate IDs
generation_guarantees: Local reference namespace and positive ordinal syntax
reference_contract.legacy_policy: Only valid original one-based indices retain their meaning; zero/out-of-range/wrong-namespace references are never guessed or shifted

reference_transport_budget: Same slots/source/order/outputs; finite typed source enum and local address patterns. Complete source preserved, no extra calls.
